title: The editor used for Java development
answer: I use IntelliJ IDEA as my Java development IDE. In this AeroTopo project it is configured around Java 21, Maven, Spring Boot, Git, the integrated terminal, and automated tests. I prefer it because it combines strong Java code intelligence, navigation, refactoring, debugging, build integration, and Spring-aware tooling in one workspace. I still rely on the underlying JDK, Maven, Git, and command-line tools, so the project remains reproducible outside the IDE as well.

steps.title: Open the Java project in IntelliJ
steps.question: The project view shows that IntelliJ is the working environment around the actual Java codebase rather than an abstract preference. An editor answer is stronger when it reflects the environment you actually use. Why does opening the real AeroTopo workspace make “I use IntelliJ IDEA” more meaningful than simply naming an editor?
steps.why: The project view shows that IntelliJ is the working environment around the actual Java codebase rather than an abstract preference.
steps.why_te: Workspace ni folder list laga chudakandi; ee project later code, build mariyu tooling decisions ki common context ela istundo first observe cheddam. Real AeroTopo workspace ni IntelliJ lo open cheyyadam valla idi just preference kaadani, actual project development environment ani clear avutundi. Ee step complete ayyaka "Open the Java project in IntelliJ" ni tool action laga kaakunda concept ki evidence laga mee own words lo explain cheyyagalali.

steps.title: Confirm the project JDK
steps.question: The project SDK connects editor analysis, compilation assumptions, language features, and navigation to the Java version used by the project. A Java IDE must understand the same JDK level that the build expects. What does checking IntelliJ's Project SDK tell you about the editor's role in this Java 21 project?
steps.why: The project SDK connects editor analysis, compilation assumptions, language features, and navigation to the Java version used by the project.
steps.why_te: Java/JVM terms ni separate definitions laga memorize cheyyakandi; source, compiler, bytecode, runtime flow lo ee screen ekkada fit avutundo mentally map cheskundam. Project SDK check chesthe editor analysis, compilation assumptions, language features mariyu navigation Java 21 baseline tho align ayyi unnayani telustundi. Ee step complete ayyaka "Confirm the project JDK" ni tool action laga kaakunda concept ki evidence laga mee own words lo explain cheyyagalali.

steps.title: Open the application entry point
steps.question: IntelliJ understands Java source structure, packages, types, imports, and framework annotations instead of treating the file as unstructured text. An IDE should make source navigation fast in a growing Java project. Why is opening `AeroTopoApplication.java` a useful demonstration of IntelliJ as more than a plain text editor?
steps.why: IntelliJ understands Java source structure, packages, types, imports, and framework annotations instead of treating the file as unstructured text.
steps.why_te: Mundu AeroTopoApplication.java ni enduku open chestunnamo context set cheskundam; file kanipinchagane next step ki vellakunda concept ki evidence ekkada undo chuddam. IntelliJ Java source ni plain text laga kaakunda packages, types, imports mariyu annotations tho structured code ga understand chestundi. Ee step complete ayyaka "Open the application entry point" ni tool action laga kaakunda concept ki evidence laga mee own words lo explain cheyyagalali.

steps.title: Inspect Maven integration
steps.question: The IDE can expose the same Maven lifecycle and dependency model used by command-line builds and CI. Java development usually depends on a build tool outside the editor itself. Why does having Maven integrated into IntelliJ matter when describing the editor you use?
steps.why: The IDE can expose the same Maven lifecycle and dependency model used by command-line builds and CI.
steps.why_te: Green status chudadam matrame target kaadu; ee result exact ga ye project assumption ni verify chestundo evidence laga chuddam. IntelliJ Maven integration valla IDE lo kanipinche build lifecycle mariyu dependency model command line mariyu CI tho same source nundi vastayi. Ee step complete ayyaka "Inspect Maven integration" ni tool action laga kaakunda concept ki evidence laga mee own words lo explain cheyyagalali.

steps.title: Inspect Spring support
steps.question: Framework-aware views help connect Java classes to Spring runtime concepts and reduce navigation effort in a larger application. A Spring Boot developer works with beans, mappings, configuration, and application lifecycle in addition to Java syntax. Why is Spring-aware tooling one reason to use IntelliJ for this project?
steps.why: Framework-aware views help connect Java classes to Spring runtime concepts and reduce navigation effort in a larger application.
steps.why_te: Spring ni magic laga chudakandi; source class/annotation nundi runtime bean leda mapping varaku relation ni ee view lo trace cheyyandi. Spring-aware tooling Java classes ni beans, mappings mariyu runtime concepts tho connect chestundi. Large application lo navigation effort taggutundi. Ee step complete ayyaka "Inspect Spring support" ni tool action laga kaakunda concept ki evidence laga mee own words lo explain cheyyagalali.

steps.title: Open the integrated terminal
steps.question: It keeps Java, Maven, Git, and diagnostics accessible in the same workspace while preserving direct command-line verification. Using an IDE should not hide the actual command-line tools behind proprietary buttons. Why is IntelliJ's integrated terminal important to your development workflow?
steps.why: It keeps Java, Maven, Git, and diagnostics accessible in the same workspace while preserving direct command-line verification.
steps.why_te: Terminal ni separate tool laga kaakunda same project workspace lo direct verification channel laga chudandi; IDE view mariyu command-line reality okate state ni reflect chestunnaya ani compare cheyyandi. Integrated terminal valla Java, Maven, Git mariyu diagnostic commands same workspace lo direct ga run cheyyachu. IDE buttons meeda matrame depend avvalsina avasaram undadu.

steps.title: Verify the workspace with Maven tests
steps.question: Running the repository's Maven tests provides a reproducible final check that the IDE environment agrees with the real project build. If IntelliJ is your development IDE, what practical evidence shows that the editor, JDK, build configuration, and project dependencies are working together correctly?
steps.why: Running the repository's Maven tests provides a reproducible final check that the IDE environment agrees with the real project build.
steps.why_te: Green status chudadam matrame target kaadu; ee result exact ga ye project assumption ni verify chestundo evidence laga chuddam. Maven tests success ayithe IntelliJ environment, JDK, dependencies mariyu project build okate configuration meeda correct ga work chestunnayani practical proof vastundi. Ee step complete ayyaka "Verify the workspace with Maven tests" ni tool action laga kaakunda concept ki evidence laga mee own words lo explain cheyyagalali.
